entities.summary: Dadvan Ismat Yousuf Yousuf is an Iraqi-born cryptocurrency investor and businessman. He became known in Switzerland for early investments in bitcoin and other cryptocurrencies and later founded the Dohrnii Foundation, a cryptocurrency education project that issued the DHN token. Some media outlets described him as the youngest Swiss self-made millionaire. In 2021 he was included in the Forbes 30 Under 30 list for the DACH region. His business activities later drew regulatory scrutiny from the Swiss Financial Market Supervisory Authority (FINMA), which ordered the dissolution of the Dohrnii Foundation in 2023.

historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: Dadvan Yousuf's early investments in bitcoin and other cryptocurrencies led to his inclusion in Forbes' 30 Under 30 list for the DACH region in 2021, marking a notable regional impact on cryptocurrency adoption. His business activities also drew regulatory scrutiny from FINMA, leading to the dissolution of the Dohrnii Foundation in 2023.
